# Staking WETH

> Staking WETH is a guide and interface for turning WETH into a staked ETH position. Because Ethereum consensus staking uses native ETH, WETH is usually unwrapped 1:1 first, then staked natively or through liquid staking that returns an LST. The page is non-custodial: users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- WETH is the ERC-20 wrapper of ETH and converts to ETH at a fixed 1:1 rate.
- Ethereum consensus staking uses native ETH, so WETH is typically unwrapped before staking.
- Unwrapping WETH costs only gas and has no slippage or trading fee.
- Liquid staking returns a liquid staking token that represents the staked position.
- Gas is paid in native ETH, so a wallet holding only WETH cannot sign transactions.

## Pages

- Staking WETH & learn: https://staking-weth.github.io/
- Legal: https://staking-weth.github.io/legal.html
